bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
COMPOSE="$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test -f "$COMPOSE"
CID=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test -n "$CID"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$COMPOSE" exec -T postgres psql -X -A -F '|' -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
SELECT 'ROOM15',a.announcement_id,a.kind,a.status,a.accept_applications,r.status,r.join_visibility,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM announcement_applications ap WHERE ap.announcement_id=a.announcement_id) AS applications,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posting_deliveries d WHERE d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.status='sent') AS sent_deliveries,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM announcement_notifications n WHERE n.announcement_id=a.announcement_id AND n.event_key LIKE 'application:%:submitted') AS queued_notifications
FROM announcement_posts a LEFT JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=a.room_id WHERE a.announcement_id=15;
SELECT 'ROOM_RECENT',a.announcement_id,a.kind,a.status,a.accept_applications,r.status,r.join_visibility,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM announcement_applications ap WHERE ap.announcement_id=a.announcement_id),
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posting_deliveries d WHERE d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.status='sent')
FROM announcement_posts a JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=a.room_id
ORDER BY a.announcement_id DESC LIMIT 6;
SELECT 'APP15_STATUS',status,COUNT(*),COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE consented_profile IS NOT NULL)
FROM announcement_applications WHERE announcement_id=15 GROUP BY status;
SELECT 'APP15_AGE', COUNT(*), MAX(created_at) > NOW()-INTERVAL '60 minutes' AS fresh_created, MAX(updated_at) > NOW()-INTERVAL '60 minutes' AS fresh_updated
FROM announcement_applications WHERE announcement_id=15;
SELECT 'NOTICE15',state,COUNT(*) FROM announcement_notifications WHERE announcement_id=15 GROUP BY state;
SQL
printf 'LOG_MARKERS\n'
docker logs --since=75m "$CID" 2>&1 | grep -Eo '\[(ROOM_[A-Z0-9_]+|ROOM_OWNER_APPLICATION_NOTICE_NOT_DELIVERED|GAYBBS_[A-Z0-9_]+)\]' | sort | uniq -c | head -40 || true
echo DIAGNOSTIC_READ_ONLY_DONE
